usage: agentware skill [-h] <subcommand> ...

positional arguments:
  <subcommand>
    list               list authored catalog skills
    search             search the catalog by name/summary/tag
    validate           validate catalog skills (frontmatter name==folder, vet
                       clean)
    add                vet + install a TRUSTED catalog skill into the KB (or a
                       harness path)
    remove             unregister + remove a KB-installed skill
    roster-injectable  exit 0 iff a rendered roster file has >=1 real always-
                       on entry (shared predicate the SessionStart hook +
                       index-validate linter call)
    sync               reconcile KB skills/ -> per-machine vetted execution
                       cache (quarantine-on-change; --approve to install)
    candidates         detect cohesive recurring learnings + PROPOSE tier-2
                       skill-candidate workorders (DRAFT, never auto-started;
                       --dry-run to rank only)
    propose            create-or-increment an agent-PROPOSED skill under
                       skills-proposed/ (recall-only candidate; graduates to
                       always-on via `skill promote`)
    proposals          list staged skill proposals + their frequency counts
                       (--ripe filters)
    promote            human-gated promotion of a PROPOSED skill into the
                       always-on skills/ tier (requires --reviewed-by; runs
                       vet_skill_dir; BLOCKS on findings)

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
